---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Activity)) |>
  add_count(Activity, name = "total") |>
  filter(total >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, total, Fatal_clean) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = fct_reorder(Activity, total), fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Fatal" = "#d95f02", "Non-fatal" = "#7570b3"),
    name = "Outcome"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs. Non-Fatal Shark Attacks by Activity",
    subtitle = "Activities with at least 50 recorded incidents",
    x = "Number of Attacks",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
